rhqry621.variantName: Christmas Tree World 3ft Snowy LED Frosted Pine Fibre Optic Tree
rhqry621.sourceDescription: Following in the footsteps of our popular Snowy Scots Pine tree, this 3ft fibre optic tree is the ideal festive antidote to dull evenings. Coming with lightly flocked bottle brush style branches, mini acrylic flowers and pre-attached pine cones, it really is a stunning 3ft fibre optic tree that you'll be eager to display in your home. Many of our customers love this tree as it offers a more low-key version of a fully frosted Christmas tree and doesn't demand attention like our all-over kaleidoscopic fibre optics. An affordable option for anyone looking to light up their home with a sprinkling of Yuletide charm, the 3ft Snowy Frosted Pine fibre optic tree is the ultimate choice for any Xmas lover! Picture shows 6ft tree in the range. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase.
